best: First solo flights and landing practice.
desc: The school's friendly first airplane. Slow, stable, and forgiving — it practically wants to fly straight. Every pilot starts here.
name: Skyhopper T-1 Trainer
style: in the style of a classic high-wing trainer

desc: A slightly faster trainer with room for the whole family. Great for cross-country student flights.
name: Cloudrunner C-2
style: in the style of a low-wing touring prop

best: Understanding lift, stalls, and gentle landings.
desc: No engine — just wings and wind. Teaches the purest flying: reading the air, finding lift, landing softly.
name: Albatross G-1 Glider
style: in the style of a modern sailplane

desc: Hovers, spins, and lands on a dime. Trickier than airplanes — the stick does more jobs at once.
name: Whirlybird H-4
style: in the style of a light utility helicopter

desc: A zippy little sport plane for pilots who have the basics down. Quick rolls, steep climbs, big grins.
name: Dart Racer R-3
style: in the style of a sport aerobatic monoplane

desc: Fast, smooth, and high-flying. Your first taste of jet speed and flying above the weather.
name: Comet Cruiser C-9
style: in the style of a twin-engine business jet

desc: Lands on runways AND water. Double the landing practice, double the fun.
name: Sunseeker A-6 Amphibian
style: in the style of an amphibious seaplane

desc: Military-style speed and power. Demands respect — everything happens twice as fast up here.
name: Thunderbolt J-7
style: in the style of a single-engine fighter jet

best: Heavy aircraft handling and ILS landings.
desc: The queen of the skies. Heavy, graceful, and complex — landing this smoothly is a true pilot's badge.
name: Sky Giant G-800
style: in the style of a four-engine jumbo airliner

desc: Twin-engine thunder built for the edge of the envelope. Only for pilots with cool heads.
name: Stormchaser S-5
style: in the style of a twin-engine air-superiority fighter

best: Precision night flying and systems management.
desc: Flies like a shadow. Unstable by design — the computer helps, but the pilot must stay ahead of it.
name: Night Owl N-2
style: in the style of a flying-wing stealth aircraft

best: The final exam: rocket climb and dead-stick landing.
desc: A rocket with wings. Climbs like an elevator to the edge of space. The ultimate graduation flight.
name: Starhopper X-1 Rocket
style: in the style of an experimental rocket plane
